images.title: 83 minus 38
images.purpose: Shows that 83 − 38 = 45, which is 9 times the digit difference 8 − 3.
images.composition: One column subtraction in the centre with the factor form to its right.
images.exact_structure: Centre: a column subtraction, 83 on top, − 38 below it, a horizontal line, and 45 under the line. In 83 and in 38 the digit 8 is teal #0072B2 and the digit 3 is amber #E69F00. To the right of 45, on the same line: = 9 × (8 − 3), where 8 is teal, 3 is amber and the 9 is reddish purple #CC79A7. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.
